nodes.description: address public owner declared in Ownable; holds the privileged owner account
bool public paused declared in Pausable; circuit breaker flag for token transfers
string public name of the ERC20 token, set in the constructor
string public symbol of the ERC20 token, set in the constructor
uint8 public decimals used for display scaling of token amounts
uint256 initialSupply internal variable used as the base for the total supply computation
uint256 totalSupply_ storage backing totalSupply(), mutable by burn()
mapping(address => uint256) balances holding the token balance of each account
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed holding ERC20 allowances
SafeMath.mul(uint256,uint256) internal pure multiplication with overflow assertion
SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256) internal pure division helper
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256) internal pure subtraction with underflow assertion
SafeMath.add(uint256,uint256) internal pure addition with overflow assertion
Ownable() constructor that assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable
onlyOwner modifier requiring msg.sender == owner; the primary access-control gate
transferOwnership(address) onlyOwner function that reassigns the owner address
pause() onlyOwner whenNotPaused function that sets paused = true
unpause() onlyOwner whenPaused function that sets paused = false
whenNotPaused modifier requiring !paused, applied to transfer/transferFrom/approve/pause
whenPaused modifier requiring paused, applied to unpause
ERC20 interface declaration of totalSupply()
ERC20 interface declaration of balanceOf(address)
ERC20 interface declaration of allowance(address,address)
ERC20 interface declaration of transfer(address,uint256)
ERC20 interface declaration of transferFrom(address,address,uint256)
ERC20 interface declaration of approve(address,uint256)
PointPowerCoin() constructor that mints the total supply to owner and sets token metadata
totalSupply() view returning totalSupply_
transfer(address,uint256) whenNotPaused function moving balances from msg.sender
balanceOf(address) view returning balances[_owner]
transferFrom(address,address,uint256) whenNotPaused function spending allowances
approve(address,uint256) whenNotPaused function setting allowances for msg.sender
allowance(address,address) view returning allowed[_owner][_spender]
burn(uint256) onlyOwner function destroying tokens and reducing totalSupply_
payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain Ether transfers
distribute(address,uint256) onlyOwner function moving tokens from the owner balance
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller used for ownership, allowances and balance mutations
Multiplication c = a * b inside SafeMath.mul, guarded only by an assert on the division result
Addition c = a + b inside SafeMath.add, guarded by assert(c >= a)
Subtraction a - b inside SafeMath.sub, guarded by assert(b <= a)
initialSupply * 10 ** uint(decimals) supply computation in the constructor, performed without SafeMath
